verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation that generated Floot apps can make built-in LLM calls or run agents at runtime without the user supplying provider keys. The closest items are generate_image, which writes images into the project at build time, and Floot-brokered OAuth, which is a different capability. The integrations docs say third-party keys are typed in by the user through a secure dialog, which suggests users do manage provider keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself
